company.name: Inspectify
company.shortDescription: Inspectify aims to develop a platform that helps inspectors, real estate professionals and home buyers alike.
company.description: We founded Inspectify with the goal to make a platform that helps inspectors, real estate professionals, and homebuyers alike. We see a tremendous opportunity to apply the latest technology to make inspectors more proficient and effective and make home inspections more engaging and value add to home buyers. We are just getting started, but are excited to provide much-needed disruption in the space!

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $5,260,000, or 23.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,571,675 to $75,018,734, a 29.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
